theme: An open Saturday with a board to clear before tomorrow.
greeting: The calendar is empty today, Dan — the girls are with you in St. Pete and the day is yours. The weight is all on tomorrow: the 9 AM board review, where a few long-slipped items are waiting.

needsAttention.detail: Your 15-minute board review with Mike is at 9 AM tomorrow. Several [DAN] items have slipped for weeks — worth deciding what lives and what dies before you sit down.

needsAttention.title: Maine Christmas SUV still unbooked
needsAttention.detail: The p1 'book this week' rental is roughly six weeks past due. A full-size SUV out of Portland over Christmas sells out — a refundable hold now removes the whole risk.

needsAttention.title: December break still undecided
needsAttention.detail: Shortlist-and-decide for the three-week trip with all four girls was due Sept 30, book by Oct 15 — both passed. Pick domestic vs. international and move.

needsAttention.detail: A final reminder says the account is over its storage limit and files go on Oct 25 unless you clear space or upgrade.
